## What's new

Describe the changes users will notice, with links to relevant guides. Include notable fixes and any known limitations.

## Install

- **Mac:** download the `aarch64.dmg` for Apple Silicon or `x64.dmg` for Intel. Open the DMG and drag FalconDeck into Applications. The release workflow signs and notarizes the installers.
- **iPhone and iPad:** [download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/falcondeck/id6760899257), then pair from Settings → Remote Access in the Mac app.
